notes.title: Building, Science and Leaderboards
notes.content:
[h3]Workers are now needed to build turrets. [/h3]
Turrets are built in turn along with the buildings of the base. Turrets require 200 materia to build, so be careful with the number of turrets doubly. Unfinished turrets also passively consume power. These innovations are intended to make the first minutes of the battle more tactically and strategically diverse. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40812293/bf67c8ae0d23651de2dcc29f68bc3f187f8311f6.png[/img]

[h2]Leaderboards[/h2]
Added [b]Steam leaderboards [/b] to the game, where everyone can show their skills:
[list]
[*] The time that the defense lasted 
[*] Number of killed replicators
[/list]

[h3]New branch of ship upgrades.[/h3]
No enemy can hide from the improved engine. And thanks to the new skill of hyper-acceleration, the ship can instantly cover the distances between waves with ease. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40812293/937e50ccc8748fb96329114851ca921a7edc2dd3.png[/img]

[h3]Rebalancing science.[/h3]
Significantly reduced the chance of getting science from regular replicators. The chance now depends on the size and strength of the slain replicator. Hunters bring three times more science. The lab bonus has also been reduced.

notes.title: Tutorial update
notes.content:
[h3]Added a new game tutorial with 5 levels:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Cursor manipulation
[*] Main weapons (Gun & Laser)
[*] Turrets placement
[*] Buildings on base
[*] Pointers to enemy waves
[/olist]

[h3]Turrets can be built on sphere around base - just build them.[/h3]
By default new turrets are placed on sphere around base. But you still can place them manually using T+Space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40812293/f10c0c60d0c1f48b3567edbee725e4ec7f6e577c.png[/img]

New UI  pointers - arrow to enemy gate.

And many other UI, performance, gameplay, balance, achievements improvements
